subject.title: fix(cron): expose flat cron job fields and normalize malformed tool args

question: Should the cron agent tool advertise flat model, fallbacks, and toolsAllow fields for model-generated scheduled agent turns?
rationale: The implementation matches existing cron runtime fields, but exposing provider selection and tool allow-list controls in the flat model-facing schema is a product and security-boundary decision rather than a mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Accept the bounded exposure
options.body: Land the PR as-is and treat model, fallbacks, and toolsAllow as supported flat cron fields while leaving contextTokens and maxSpendUsd separate.

options.title: Narrow the flat surface
options.body: Ask the PR to advertise only schedule and message fields, leaving model routing and tool access overrides to a separate maintainer decision.

options.title: Pause for the wider cron contract
options.body: Hold this PR until maintainers decide the full scheduled agent-turn control contract, including the remaining context and spend fields.

recommendation.title: Accept the bounded exposure
recommendation.body: Land the PR as-is and treat model, fallbacks, and toolsAllow as supported flat cron fields while leaving contextTokens and maxSpendUsd separate.

likelyOwner.reason: The most sensitive unresolved choice is flat toolsAllow exposure, and mmaps has the clearest merged history on scheduled-turn tool policy.
